AboutCredits

This site was made out of courtesy, and in the general interest of everyone who files paperwork for the department.

The aim is simple: one unitary place for everything you need, kept as simple as possible and with as many automations as possible. Fewer fields to retype, fewer formatting mistakes, and one click to copy.

One placeAs simple as possibleAs automated as possible

Creator & maintainer

Structure

  • Patrol Reports

  • Updates

What's in it

  • Arrest Report with sentencing, fines and bail calculator
  • Incident, Supplemental, Use of Force, Traffic Collision, APB and King Patrol
  • Arrest, Search, Electronic Surveillance and Financial Service warrants
  • Bureau forms: K9, NCCIT, TSD Citation, SIB, FTP, PEU letters, SSB requests and more
  • Business Card, Email Template and Correspondence

FTPPhase 2 Report

GRADING SYSTEM — INSTRUCTIONS:

S — A rating of S (Superior) denotes outstanding performance and shall only be attributed if the trainee exceeds expectations.

C — A rating of C (Competent) is the minimum required to be considered at standard for a solo patrol deputy.

N/I — A rating of N/I (Needs Improvement) shall be ticked to denote needing further training focused on a specific task.

N/O — A rating of N/O (Not Observed) shall be ticked for all situations that were not encountered in the patrol.

NRT — A rating of NRT (Not Responding to Training) shall be given if the trainee does not respond to training.

FTPFTO Evaluation Patrol Report

GRADES:

S — A rating of S (Superior) denotes outstanding performance and shall only be assigned when the candidate exceeds expectations.

C — A rating of C (Competent) denotes performance that meets the minimum standard required of a field training officer.

N/O — A rating of N/O (Not Observed) shall be selected for any task, area, or situation that was not observed during the evaluation.

Releasev2.1.8November 4, 2026

v2.1.8

Arrest Report and Citations

  • Updated the penal code to match the game: 142 Failure to Appear at Court now also covers release as part of a bail order, 314 Vandalism of Prison Property now covers any tangible personal property leased or owned by the institution (and its misdemeanor and felony entries note the $950 damage threshold), 423 Obstructing Traffic has its new description, 420 Vehicular Endangerment now adds a 7 day vehicle impound and a 7 day license suspension, and 301 Arson now carries a $20,000 fine.
  • Added the new law 715 Possession of a Firearm Supressing or Muffling Device, a Class C (4) felony of 2 to 5 days of imprisonment. It is also in the charge search of the incident reports, together with 714.
  • Checked 425 Imprudent Driving against the new text: it was already up to date.

Patrol Reports

  • Added the Supplemental Use of Force Report as its own page under Use of Force Report in the sidebar, the same way Supplemental Report sits under Incident Report. Its fields are Time & Date (calendar, 24-hour time and a Now button), Location (the same street and district picker as the Use of Force Report), Filed By, Unit Number and Narrative, written in the official supplemental BBCode format. The Forum button goes to the same Use of Force forum as the Use of Force Report.
  • Filed By and Unit Number are prefilled from Character Details and stay editable.
  • Both Use of Force pages now start with a This is a Supplemental switch. Turning it on in the Use of Force Report takes you to the Supplemental page, and turning it off there takes you back. The two forms stay separate, so what you typed in one is not lost when you switch.

Releasev2.1.7November 4, 2026

v2.1.7

SSB — Scientific Services Bureau

  • New Forensic Lab Workspace under CSIU, brought over from the standalone workspace file so everything now lives on this site. It opens with a dashboard and has Report Generator, Characters, Evidence Identifier Manager, Evidence Records, Search and Settings / Backups.
  • Report Generator: nine report types with their exact BBCode templates (Crime Scene, Vehicle Processing, Positive Match Notification, DNA Profiling, Friction Ridge Examination, Forensic Ballistics, Trace Analysis, Narcotics Analysis and Toxicology), with a live formatted preview, raw BBCode view, copy and TXT download, version history with restore, duplicate, mark as completed, and a missing-field warning. Matched, unmatched and deceased profiles are colour-coded, fingerprint and DNA strings are decoded into names automatically, the ballistics report has the IBIS match checkbox, and the narcotics report fills its results from pasted in-game lab logs.
  • Case packages: build several reports for one scene, fill the shared details once, reorder them and copy everything as a single forum message. The package list was redesigned, with the name and the report count on the left (for example 3 reports, or No reports yet) and small Open and Delete buttons on the right.
  • Evidence Identifier Manager: paste a chatlog to extract DNA strings, fingerprint (AFIS) strings and firearm serial numbers, with duplicates removed and each unique identifier kept once. Identifiers can be edited, removed, added by hand and copied or downloaded as a list, and the Evidence Records tab lists the evidence bags found in the logs.
  • Your name and rank from Character Details are used for the “Submitted by” signature, since you are the one filling the report: the first character is created from them automatically and a new character starts with them filled in, all editable. Requesting parties, investigators and team leaders are never prefilled, because those are other people.
  • Characters keep the signature (name, title and image) used on the “Submitted by” block of each report. Global Search looks through sessions, identifiers, bags, reports and chatlogs, and Settings / Backups holds the extraction rules and the JSON backup and restore.
  • Fixed the Forensic Lab Workspace staying on screen on every other page after it was opened.
  • The workspace got a full design pass: cleaner cards and tabs, a report editor with grouped sections and a preview that stays in view while you fill it in, list rows with their buttons on the right, icons on the dashboard tiles, and clearer empty states. A Sessions tab and an active-session chip were added so each case or investigation can be kept separate.
  • Every date in the workspace now uses the site's own calendar instead of typing the date by hand (the report dates, the arrest date, the package date and the search range), each with a Now button. The toxicology Date and time field has the calendar plus a time box and a Now button that uses UK time.
  • The file choosers (signature image and backup restore) were redesigned, with the chosen file name shown.
  • Backups & settings: a file chosen for restore is shown with a Remove file button, and Restore has a Clear button next to it.
  • Characters: equal-height fields, the signature image next to its upload field with an instant preview and a Clear image button, and the same Title / rank dropdown as Character Details (same ranks, plus the laboratory titles and the Custom option with its own box).
  • Deleting the active session now switches to another one (or recreates an empty Workspace if it was the last), instead of leaving the whole workspace without a session.
  • Fixes found while testing every button and field: opening Report Generator from the tab bar while a report was open no longer drops you back into that report, a search result for a report now opens that report, and pressing Enter in the add-identifier and package-name boxes works.
  • The site now stays on the page you are on when you refresh. The page is kept in the address (for example #forensic-lab), so the link can also be shared.
  • Everything is saved in your browser on this device. Use the JSON backup to move your data to another browser. The workspace follows the site's light and dark theme and no longer depends on any other file.

Credits

  • Moutstick is now credited, for providing the file and the logic that were used for the SSB forms.

Releasev2.1.6November 4, 2026

v2.1.6

VST — Veterinary Services Team

  • The K9 Emergency Medical Care Report has a denser layout: short answers line up several to a row (the three emergency survey answers together, the nine clinical survey answers in a 3 by 3 block, the four laboratory tests in one row), and it drops to two columns on a phone.
  • The BBCode preview at the bottom of the three new veterinary forms is removed. The Copy BBCode button is all you need.
  • Release notes now show the release date next to the version number, starting with this release.

Releasev2.1.5

v2.1.5

VST — Veterinary Services Team

  • On the K9 Checkup Card, picking Abnormal on a system no longer opens a box for the finding. The system is written as Abnormal and all the findings go together in the Comments/Findings section below.

Technology & Support Division

  • The Fleet Management Unit (FMU) now sits under the Communications & Fleet Management Bureau (CFMB), as a sub-category in the same way as CSIU and DFU sit under SSB. The Fleet Maintenance Request is unchanged. The Nelson Moler Communications Center (NMCC) is listed under CFMB too, with no forms for now. CFMB is no longer greyed out, and FMU shows both its short form and its full name in the sidebar and on the home Bureaus panel.

Releasev2.1.4

v2.1.4

VST — Veterinary Services Team

  • The K9 Checkup Card now grades its fields the way the Field Training Program does: one row per item with a set of buttons, grouped in boxes, instead of dropdowns. The nine examination systems are Normal, Abnormal or Not examined (Abnormal opens a box for the finding), the five vaccinations are Up to Date, Overdue, Administered Today or Not Applicable, and the heartworm test, preventatives and laboratory tests have their own button rows. Defaults and the BBCode are unchanged.

Releasev2.1.3

v2.1.3

VST — Veterinary Services Team

  • Three new forms under VST in Technology & Support Division, next to the Veterinary Services Request: the K9 Emergency Medical Care Report, the K9 Checkup Card and the Laboratory Services Report.
  • K9 Emergency Medical Care Report: Header, Emergency survey, Clinical survey, Laboratory & Diagnostic Tests, and Medications & Treatments, in the official BBCode format. The forum topic title is generated live from the K-9 Name as [K9 Name] Emergency Care (a leading K9 or K-9 is not doubled), with its own Copy title button. The signature quotes are always left empty, to be signed on the forum.
  • K9 Checkup Card: a Type of visit selector switches between First Checkup, Follow-up Checkup and Medical Test, and what you typed is kept when switching. The checkups cover the patient information, physical examination (nine systems set to Normal, Abnormal or Not examined, with a field for the finding), vaccinations and preventatives, laboratory tests, medications and the next scheduled checkup. Each mode has its own template. Medical Test writes the Medical Tests block from a lab report link and a topic name. The title is [K9 Name] Patient Card.
  • Laboratory Services Report: one form for Autopsy, Biopsy and Blood Screening, with a Report type selector that keeps what you typed in the other types. The title follows the type, for example [VET-#NUMBER] Autopsy Report, and #NUMBER is left as it is, to be replaced with the real ID on the forum. Date and time is written as 04/Nov/2026 - 14:30. Autopsy has collapsible sections, Biopsy has a biopsy type picker with an Other field and staining suggestions, and Blood Screening reveals the result fields of each ticked test and leaves unticked tests out of the BBCode (the ranges in the fields are a guide only). Biopsy and Blood Screening have a Copy AI prompt button, and a collapsible Notify requester & supervisor section writes the two reply quotes to post under the report.
  • All three forms have a Posting as a Civilian alternate character switch with a single Name and surname box, which adds a [postas=Name Surname,CIV] line before the BBCode.
  • The Veterinarian is prefilled from Character Details and stays editable. The Handler is not prefilled, since the person filing is not the handler. The Open VST Forum buttons go to the Veterinary Services Team, Patient Files and Laboratory Services forums.
  • The Service Request Details on the Veterinary Services Request are now icon chips with a tick, like the Deployment Type chips on the K9 forms. The BBCode is unchanged.

Character Details

  • Rank now has a Custom option. Picking it opens a box below to type your own rank, which is saved with your details and used everywhere your rank appears, exactly as typed.

Sidebar

  • The counters in the Bureaus section of the sidebar are now worked out from the same list as the home page, so they always match (Technology & Support Division was showing 4 instead of its real number of forms). The Bureaus total now counts forms.
  • The Sections outline on the right of the checkup and laboratory forms only lists the sections of the selected type.

Releasev2.1.2

v2.1.2

Credits

  • A new Credits page at the very bottom of the sidebar, under About. It explains that the site was made out of courtesy and in the general interest, and that the aim is one unitary place for everything needed, as simple as possible and with as many automations as possible.
  • GitHub and Discord boxes at the top: GitHub opens the project, and the Discord box copies the username.
  • A box for each person, three to a row, with a short row centred when there are fewer. The first credits cirano for the structure and the forms; the second credits booskit and the MDC Panel +, where the Arrest Report was taken from before being made easier to use.

Releasev2.1.1

v2.1.1

Technology & Support Division

  • Scientific Services Bureau (SSB) is now the main bureau for the division's evidence requests, with two sub-categories under it, in the same way as TSD, K9 and NCCIT sit under Senora Station: CSIU (Crime Scene Investigation Unit) and DFU (Digital Forensics Unit).
  • The Laboratory Services Request moved under CSIU, and the Digital Forensics Request is under DFU. Both forms are unchanged.
  • LSU (Laboratory Services Unit) and the separate DFU unit are removed from the division.
  • CSIU and DFU now show both their short form and their full name (CSIU, Crime Scene Investigation Unit; DFU, Digital Forensics Unit), in the sidebar and on the home Bureaus panel, the same way units like SSB and FMU are shown.

Releasev2.1.0

v2.1.0

Davis Station

  • TSD › Citation now also appears under Davis Station, next to K9. It opens the same Citation form as the one under Senora Station, so the form, its narrative and its report are identical from either place.

Technology & Support Division

  • NMCC (Nelson Moler Communications Center) and CSIU (Crime Scene Investigation Unit) are removed from the Technology & Support Division.

Releasev2.0.9

v2.0.9

PEU — Administrative File

  • The checklist now only has the Pre-Employment Unit checklist, with two items side by side: Application and Written Test (WT). The Supervisor WT Grade Approval, Sergeant and Training Bureau Operations items are removed from the page and from the copied BBCode, since those are handled in the forum. An open box is still written as [cb][/cb] and a ticked one as [cbc][/cbc].

Releasev2.0.8

v2.0.8

PEU — Pre-Employment Unit

  • Pre-Employment Unit (under Personnel Command) is no longer empty. It has two pages: Applicant Letters and Administrative File.
  • Applicant Letters: one form for all eight Deputy Sheriff Trainee letters, chosen from a grouped list: Application (Received, On-Hold, Accepted, Disqualified), Written Test (Passed, Failed) and Academy (Passed, Failed). Pick the date (it starts on today, UK time), salutation and applicant name. On-Hold has a list of issues to correct, Disqualified has tick-boxes for the reasons (none ticked to start) plus an optional OOC reasoning, and Academy Failed has an optional OOC reason. Every letter is signed by Sheriff Grant Mendez and Division Chief Richard Dunne, and an Open Applications Forum button next to Copy goes straight to the forum.
  • Administrative File: build the thread title ([DST] Firstname Lastname [TAG]) with a status tag and see what each tag means, then fill in the administrative file with the applicant name, application link, notes and a checklist (an open box is written as [cb][/cb], a ticked one as [cbc][/cbc]). The applicant name is shared between both pages, and an Open Administrative Forum button next to Copy goes straight to the forum.

Releasev2.0.7

v2.0.7

Arrest Report

  • The template narrative now opens with "At approximately 1234 hours I received call of service #12345, " (or just "At approximately 1234 hours I " when Call of Service is off), and the spot right after it is highlighted so you can see where to continue writing. The highlight is only on screen and is never part of the report; it disappears as soon as you type there.
  • Recent reports now saves automatically: any report with a suspect and at least one charge is kept as you work, without having to press Copy report or Download PNG first. The last 5 are kept, each report updates its own entry instead of adding duplicates, and Open, Reset and Undo keep following the right entry.
  • The Live preview button and its side panel are removed. The live preview at the bottom of the form stays.

Releasev2.0.6

v2.0.6

New Arrest Report

  • The Arrest Report is a new form in Patrol Reports, above Incident Report. The Sheriff's Report stays where it was, just below it.
  • Add the charges first (class, offence, addition, drug category, parole violator) and press Calculate. The sentencing, fine, points, impound, suspension and bail appear, per charge and in total, and the rest of the report unlocks. Sentences and impound/suspension are capped, Life sentences show as "Life", and STREETS / DEPA notices and stipulations are listed.
  • The report is the same table the MDC panel produces: Copy report puts it on the clipboard ready to paste, Download PNG saves an image. The preview at the bottom of the form updates as you type.
  • Your Character Details fill in the first officer, callsign and badge. Date uses the date picker, time has a Now button (UK time). District and street use the search dropdowns.

Narrative

  • The narrative starts from the template (date with st/nd/rd/th, rank, name, badge, department, callsign, suspect, time in HHMM). Call of Service (with a number field), Evaded, Resisted Arrest, Searched (with Contraband found? and an item list) and Booking add their sentences on their own lines.
  • Toggles edit the narrative in place, so anything you typed by hand is kept. "Reset to template" starts over.

Faster to use

  • Charge search shows a penalty preview and the charge definition. Press Enter on an exact charge number to pick it, duplicate a charge, or tap a recent-charge chip.
  • The form autosaves and offers to restore an unfinished report. Reset has an Undo. A checklist beside the report shows what is still missing and jumps to it.
  • Recent reports keeps your last 5 copied reports on this device, so you can reopen one. Ctrl+Enter calculates, then copies.
  • The clock icon on time fields is now visible in dark mode.

Releasev2.0.5

v2.0.5

Street and district search dropdowns

  • Every street and district field is now a search box with the full GTA World list (83 districts, 225 streets). Start typing and only the matching names are shown, with your letters in bold; pick one with the mouse or Arrow keys + Enter. Only a name from the list can be kept — anything else is cleared when you leave the field, and a single obvious match (for example "grov") completes by itself.
  • Single "Location" fields (Incident Report, Use of Force, Traffic Collision, Citation, Station Logbook, OSS Case Package) are now a Street picker and a District picker side by side. The report still prints them as "Street, District".
  • The K9 logs, Citation street fields, Subject Information road and the MCB / HB Case Package street and district fields use the same pickers.

Evidence now uses lettered exhibits everywhere

  • Incident Report, Use of Force Report, the three K9 Deployment Logs and the OSS Case Package now use the same evidence format as the MCB Case Package: Exhibit A, B, C… each with a description and its own spoiler, add / remove with automatic re-lettering, and BBCode like [*][b]Exhibit A; Description[/b] followed by the spoiler.
  • Supplemental Report evidence uses the MCB Supplemental pattern: Attachment A, B, C… with spoilers.
  • An exhibit left empty still prints as "Exhibit A; Evidence description" (as on the MCB forms). The Use of Force EL Number field is gone; put the EL number inside the exhibit text.

Involved Persons redesign

  • New record-style card on the Incident Report, OSS Case Package and the MCB / HB Case Packages: the photo on the left, name with the Deceased toggle, classification and date of birth beside it, the Deceased details opening right underneath, then a Details section and a larger Relation to Incident box. The BBCode output is unchanged.
  • The photo URL and MDC profile link fields are gone from view (also on every Person of Interest form). They are still generated from the name behind the scenes and still appear in the BBCode.
  • The picture is only looked up once you stop typing for 2 seconds, with a "Searching MDC…" spinner, instead of on every letter.
  • The default picture preview is now built into the page, so it shows even where Imgur is blocked (it used to appear as a broken image). It also shows whole instead of being cropped.

Time fields

  • A "Now" button next to every time field on the site (20 fields) fills in the current UK time (Europe/London, GMT/BST) regardless of your computer's clock, in the format that field already uses (HH:MM, HHMM or HH:MM:SS).
  • Fixed the Time & Date / Location misalignment on the Incident and Use of Force Reports (and the MCB and HB Case Packages): the labels and inputs now line up exactly, however the hint wraps.

APB

  • Bulletin Type grows from 7 to 25 options (for example Wanted for Questioning, Person of Interest, Attempt to Locate, Missing Juvenile, Silver Alert, Amber Alert, Escapee, Parole / Probation Violator, BOLO, Stolen Vehicle, Hit and Run, Armed and Dangerous, Officer Safety, Seeking Witnesses). Investigation Status grows from 3 to 21 (for example Active Investigation, Cold Case, Critical Missing, Extremely Dangerous, Do Not Approach, Suspect at Large, Suspect in Custody, Warrant Issued, Homicide, Kidnapping, Armed Robbery, Case Closed).
  • The random APB number and its button are removed. The preview, BBCode and PNG now all show "APB ####".

K9 Deployment Logs

  • Deployment Type is now a row of compact icon pills (Bite, Search Warrant, Tracking, Other) on all three K9 logs.
  • The Bite medical-care sentences now appear in the Deployment Narrative itself, where they can be read and edited, and update as you change the option or type the providing unit (they are no longer added to the BBCode separately). The wording was updated for "Yes, cleared on scene", "Yes, taken to ER" and "No".

NCCIT Personnel File and Supplemental

  • Text boxes now start compact and grow as you type, up to a limit, then scroll inside the box, so a very long entry never stretches the page.

TSD Citation

  • "Same as Defendant" is a pill; Enforcement Outcome is two Yes/No tiles; the Narrative sections and Offence Narratives are pills, with a labelled details panel opening under each ticked offence; Radar photo, Dashcam footage and the Written / Video choice are restyled to match. The citation text itself is unchanged.

Character Details redesign

  • New header card with a large avatar, your name, a "Rank · Bureau" line, and chips for badge number, callsign and whether your details are saved ("Not saved yet", "Unsaved changes" or "Saved") that update as you type.
  • The avatar shows your MDC picture when one exists and your initials when it doesn't (no name yet, still loading, or the picture can't be loaded). The picture is looked up once you stop typing for 2 seconds, and a broken image is never shown.
  • Fields are grouped into Identity (full name, rank, badge number) and Assignment (bureau, callsign) with a short hint under each. Save and Clear work exactly as before and your details still prefill the other forms when you save.

Other changes

  • Use of Force Report: IAB Response and Supervisor Response are now Yes/No tiles.
  • The OSS Incident Report is renamed Case Package (sidebar, page title and home menu); searching "incident report" still finds it. The text it posts is unchanged.
  • Business Card: three crumpled-paper looks — Crumpled · Light (the original), Crumpled · Heavy (scrunched and flattened paper with soft creases) and Folded & Worn (quarter folds with worn crease lines) — plus Plain.
  • The "Credits: cirano" label is now pinned to the bottom-right corner at every screen size.

v2.0.4

Person of Interest File — now shared by every Detective Division bureau

  • Person of Interest File (previously "MCB Person of Interest File") is renamed to just Person of Interest File and is no longer MCB-only — it now appears under all four Detective Division bureaus: MCB, Narcotics Bureau (NB), Homicide Bureau (HB), and Operation Safe Streets Bureau (OSSB). NB is no longer greyed out.
  • Every copy keeps the same fields: full name, aliases, Gang Member checkbox ([cb] / [cbc]), Status (Active, Incarcerated, Deceased, Wanted), Race with an Other field, a live MDC photo preview with an editable Image URL and MDC profile link, and open fields for physical description, associates and notes.

MCB — Major Crimes Bureau

  • MCB is no longer greyed out and holds three forms: Person of Interest, Case Package and Supplemental Report.
  • Case Package: penal codes picked from the same searchable list as the Arrest Warrant, time and date, street and district, handling investigator filled from Character Details, and additional investigators.
  • Involved Persons and Evidence start with one entry each and use + and − to add or remove more. Each person's picture uses the same name-based logic as the OSS Incident Report, and each exhibit is lettered A, B, C… with its own spoiler in the same list.
  • Supplemental Report: a Narrative field, lettered Evidence/Attachments with add/remove and their own spoilers, and a Filed By section (rank, name, badge) — no forum-link button on this form.

Homicide Bureau (HB) — now active

  • HB is no longer greyed out and holds three forms: Person of Interest, Case Package and Supplemental Report, built with the same logic as MCB's. Case Package opens to the HB forum.

Live MDC photo preview, everywhere a person's picture is used

  • Every person field across Incident Report, OSS Incident Report, and all MCB/HB/Detective Division forms shows a live photo preview next to an editable Image URL field, plus a "Use default image" button.
  • Typing a name fills in the matching MDC picture automatically. If that picture genuinely fails to load, the preview and the Image URL field both fall back to the default image — but a name with a real, working MDC picture is shown and used as-is, in the preview and in the generated BBCode.

FTP — FTO Evaluation Patrol Report

  • A new Field Training Program form: report date/time, FTO candidate and FTO names with badge numbers, ten rated Attitude items (Superior / Competent / Needs Improvement / Not Observed), Most and Least Satisfactory Performance, and a Narrative field. The Open FTP Forum button goes to the FTO evaluation forum.

Home screen

  • The welcome badge next to "Welcome back…" now shows your own MDC photo, generated from the name saved in Character Details, instead of always showing the Sheriff's seal. If that photo doesn't actually load — or no name is saved yet — it falls back to the seal.

Bureaus

v2.0.2

Form header

v2.0.1

Bureaus

  • Every unit now shows the same picture as in the sidebar menu, including Davis Station, Senora Station, CSD, SIB, VST and the units that have no forms yet. The OSS, K9, NCCIT and TSD groups inside a card show their sidebar icons too. A unit with no picture gets a small letter badge instead.

CSD — Canine Services Detail

  • Added the CSD K9 Deployment Log under CSD in Special Operations Division. It is identical to the Senora K9 Deployment Log (date, time, street, district, callsign, deployment types, Bite medical care, narrative, evidence found and signature, with Character Details autofill), except that its BBCode uses the CSD header image and the Canine Services Detail title.

VST — Veterinary Services Team

Bureaus

Releasev1.0.9

v1.0.9

Bureaus

  • Divisional Generators is now called Bureaus and is organized by division: Central Patrol Division (Davis Station, Senora Station), Special Operations Division (CSD, ESD, SED, Aero Bureau), Detective Division (MCB, NB, HB, OSSB), Personnel Command (PEU, TB, FTP), Professional Standards Bureaus (SIB, IAB, CSB) and Technology & Support Division (SSB, CFMB, NMCC, CSIU, LSU, DFU, PSB, FMU, VST).
  • Sidebar: only divisions and their units are listed. Click a division to open its units, then click a unit to see its forms. Opening one closes the others, the division of the form you are using stays open, and units with no forms yet are shown greyed out. Searching opens every matching branch automatically.
  • Home page: Bureaus is a single panel with one tab per division, and only the selected division is shown, so it stays compact as more forms are added. Searching shows matching forms from every division at once.
  • The SIB forms (Story and Activity Tracker) moved from Senora Station to SIB under Professional Standards Bureaus. The Laboratory Services, Digital Forensics and Fleet Maintenance requests moved from the old Technology & Support category to LSU, DFU and FMU under Technology & Support Division.
  • Davis Station and Senora Station keep all their current forms (OSS, K9, NCCIT, TSD, Logbook), now under Central Patrol Division.

Field Training Program

  • Added the Field Training Program (FTP) forms under Personnel Command: Phase 1 Patrol Summary and Phase 2 Report. Each form shows its instructions above the fields, and its Open FTP Forum button goes to the FTP forum.
  • Phase 1 Patrol Summary: report date, report time, phase, trainee and FTO details, an Observations field and a Delivered Theoretical Knowledge dropdown. The dropdown works like the charge picker in the warrants: search it or pick from the grouped list (Classroom & Station Orientation, Department Orientation & Professional Standards, Patrol Role & Equipment Familiarization, Legal Authority & Policy Foundations), choose as many items as needed, and each selected item is listed on its own line in the BBCode.
  • Phase 2 Report (Field Training Observational Report): all 28 ratings are listed by category (Attitude, Appearance, Relationships, Performance, The Handle, Knowledge, Roleplay) with five options next to each, S, C, N/I, N/O and NRT, and the one chosen is the one written in the BBCode. Ratings start on N/O. Least Satisfactory Performance, Most Satisfactory Performance and Report Narrative are open fields that grow taller as more text is typed. The Delivered Practical & Theoretical Knowledge dropdown covers all eight Phase 2 categories, again with one item per line in the BBCode. The Phase # can be set to Phase 2 or Phase 3.
  • Character Details autofill: FTO Name is filled with your name and FTO Employee Number with your badge number. The report date is filled with today's date through the date picker. The report time is left empty on purpose. All of them stay editable.

v1.0.8

Character Details

  • Added an optional Callsign field to Character Details. It is not mandatory: leave it blank and every callsign field stays empty, or fill it in and it prefills the Callsign / Unit Number field in each form that has one (Incident Report, Use of Force Report, King Patrol Report, NC-CIT Personnel File and Supplemental, Senora and Davis K9 Deployment Logs, Citation, and the OSS Incident and Supplemental reports). Prefilled values stay editable per form.

Generators

  • Added the Eugene Biskarrat Regional Training Center to the station selection of the Business Card Generator. Its name and address are shown at the bottom left of the card.

Releasev1.0.7

v1.0.7

Divisional Generators

  • Added the K9 division under Davis Station with a new Deployment Log form (Canine Deployment Report): date, time, street, area, callsign, selectable deployment types, narrative, evidence found and signature, with Character Details autofill for name, rank and badge number.
  • The Davis K9 BBCode uses its own header image and title, always ends the location with San Andreas, and the Open K9 Forum button goes to the Davis K9 forum.

When "No" is selected the field becomes Reason for lack of provided care.

The Open Activity Forum button leads to the SIB activity thread.

Generators

  • The previous email form has been renamed to Correspondence and works as before.

v1.0.6

Patrol Reports

  • Incident Report and OSS Incident Report: every involved person now has a Deceased check next to the Forename Surname field. Once checked, you choose between PK and CK.

Releasev1.0.4

v1.0.4

Patrol Reports

  • Incident Report: involved persons are now separated by two blank lines in the generated BBCode instead of one.
  • Incident Report: added person image logic matching the OSS Incident Report. The image URL is generated from the person's name, falls back to the default image when no name is entered, and can be edited manually. A new Use default image checkbox sets the default image URL instead of the name-based link; unchecking it returns to name-based generation.
  • Incident Report: the person image is now always included in the BBCode, right-aligned with the same alignment as the OSS Incident Report and placed after the Classification line.

Tips

  • Enter your name, badge number, rank, and bureau in Character Details. Callsign is optional: if you add one, it prefills every callsign / unit number field; if you leave it blank, those fields stay empty. Matching fields in supported forms and generators will prefill automatically.
  • Prefilled fields remain editable. Update Character Details to refresh fields that still contain their previous autofilled value.
  • Warrant dates default to today's date and can be edited. Warrant affidavits show a live preview; use Copy to copy formatted text.
  • Use the + and − controls to add or remove evidence and other repeatable entries where available.
  • Use the Reset button to clear a form and restore its default values.
